fix(runtime): clear failed startup handles

codeon:
  version: 1
  authority: FWN-16
  description: |-
    Remove dispatch-keyed termination handles whenever Cursor or Grok provider startup settles with an error or supervised panic. This prevents stale numeric process-group authority from surviving startup cleanup while preserving handles for Grok failures that still own pending cleanup.
    
    Add lifecycle regression coverage for a real Cursor startup failure and a supervised Grok startup panic.
